PC: all medications can be discontinued except the medications that relieve the symptoms.
MK:
P=a 95 year old woman with advanced dementia and several other co-existing diseases, on multiple medications, recent hospitalization

I=stop unnecessary medications

C=continue the same medication until her death

O=die comfortably (quality of life or death)
SBP: this is a case for hospice and palliative care because her expectancy is less than six months and the patient’s son requests comfort care.
